name: Studio outline view supports editing, adding and removing slides before approval
description: In Edit mode on the outline proposal, the user can rename the deck title, edit a slide title, add a slide and remove a slide, and the final CTA label reflects the updated slide count.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app root URL /, stay on the 'Studio — structured' tab, type the brief 'Content marketing strategy for a B2B SaaS: pillars, calendar, distribution, KPIs' and click 'Forge the outline'.
Wait for the 'Outline proposal' view and note the number of slides (the final button says 'Approve & write N slides').
In the deck title input (aria-label 'Deck title'), append the text ' - 2025'.
Verify the deck title now ends with ' - 2025'.
Edit the first slide title input (aria-label 'Slide title') to read 'Executive summary'.
Verify the first slide row now shows 'Executive summary'.
Verify a new slide row is appended and the final CTA now says 'Approve & write N+1 slides' (count increased by one).
Click the 'Remove slide' (trash) control on that newly added last slide row.
Verify the slide count returns to N and the CTA label shows the original count again.
